description:
In this task, you need to prepare a specific view of a surgical case for review. 

1. Vital Recorder is open with VitalDB Case #6 loaded. 
2. Zoom the timeline so that approximately 5 minutes of data is visible in the window (between 3 and 7 minutes). 
3. Navigate/Scroll the timeline so the view is centered roughly around the 20-minute mark (00:20:00) of the recording. 
4. Ensure vital sign waveforms are visible. 
5. Save a screenshot of this specific view to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\case_review_capture.png'.
